description.subtitle: Nike First Equipment T-shirt of the Corinthians 2026 2027 - white
description.tagline: Historia y orgullo en cada detalle
description.intro: The Nike Corinthians 26/27 Dri-FIT Stadium T-shirt pays tribute to one of the club’s most iconic moments. Inspired by the historic Corinthian invasion of 1976, this equipment connects the past with the present to offer a garment loaded with identity and passion.
key_benefits: Nike Dri-FIT Technology: Wicks sweat away to keep you dry and comfortable.
Official design: Inspired by the kit that marked an era in the club's history.
Total comfort: Light and breathable fabric ideal for day to day or matches.
Authentic details: Corinthians crest and official Nike finishes.
